# Pinned TMscore source

`TMscore.cpp` is the unchanged official 2022-02-27 source obtained from
https://zhanggroup.org/TM-score/TMscore.cpp, SHA-256
`02d24a35857b1076a432e97c4d63cad7993ac2cc6585a1b85a7c33031c84f8b1`.
Its original line endings and permission/copyright notices are retained.
The installer checks the hash and compiles it locally with `g++ -O3`.
This third-party source retains its own notices rather than being relicensed
under the repository's Apache-2.0 licence.
